items.text: A third US aircraft carrier, the [[p:USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71)|USS Theodore Roosevelt]], has reached the Middle East, according to Axios and Israel's Channel 12 citing a US official. That puts more than 20,000 US sailors and Marines in the region as the war with Iran passes seven months.
items.outlet: The Times of Israel (citing Axios, Channel 12)
items.notes: Arrival rests on an unnamed US official; link2 covers the deployment, not the arrival.

items.text: The [[p:Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|IRGC]] navy says two more oil tankers hit naval mines and caught fire south of the Strait of Hormuz while using an 'unauthorised' route with tracking switched off. It also claims to have shot down a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island. Neither claim has been independently verified, and US Central Command has disputed earlier IRGC mine claims.
items.notes: IRGC claims only; no ship names given.

items.text: The [[p:ASEAN]] summit opened in Manila for three days, with the Middle East war and its economic fallout at the top of the agenda. A draft statement stresses peaceful settlement of disputes and freedom of navigation in the South China Sea. Chinese Premier [[p:Li Qiang]] meets ASEAN leaders on Monday and leaves before [[p:Donald Trump]] arrives on Tuesday for a [[p:Quadrilateral Security Dialogue|Quad]] meeting, a US–ASEAN summit and talks with [[p:Bongbong Marcos]].
